name: Verla
summary: Verla showcases a honed Dover White marble top in a soft matte finish, giving the surface a calm, elegant depth. The matte white bottom panel keeps the silhouette clean and sculptural, while the fiberglass base in vintage brass brings a warm, distinguished accent. The combination delivers a modern piece with a quietly elevated character. Top honed Dover white marble (matte), bottom panel in matte white, fiberglass base paint vintage brass. 160x42x76
